notes.title: Tales of Tirunia is becoming a 4X title
notes.content:
We are pivoting into 4x


Tales of Tirunia is becoming a 4x title.

We started out our journey wanting to create an amazing PVP Live Service experience. It was an ambitious (some might say crazy) goal, especially as a first-time micro studio like ours. On top of that, it kept creeping into our decision-making process; figuring out which awesome assets should be gate behind microstransactions was a slog. We had to make decisions we didn't want to just for the sake of making money. We didn't like it.



So with that in mind, we are thrilled to announce that Tales of Tirunia is becoming a 4X title!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483983/f7cfd2209c79b319761505c5114bcdf7a80d5fc8.png"]



The transition is going to happen in phases. We had blast testing our battle system with all of you during our public playtesting session back in July. Now we are preparing for our next public session which will host the Dungeon Dwelling mode; an expansion on top of what was considered "the game" previously.



Essentially, it will work like this:

You get to choose a random character from 3 options - each having their own unique traits and benefits. Perhaps you'll want to buff your army in battles or have an easier time exploring the dungeon. Maybe you'll want to specialize in building a single army or mix-and-match units from different factions. Each run you can experience a completely different playstyle that's mainly driven by the character you choose at the start. The character here won't have any real visual indication. It's more of "this is you" type of thing.

You'll start dwelling the dungeon; on the very first floor you'll get to build out your own army. Winning a battle will yield a random defeated unit as a reward who'll want to join your forces. You'll get to decide which units you want to recruit into your army and which ones you'll abandon instead.

The new trait system will make army building extremely versatile. You can decide whether or not you want to build your army vertically, buffing all the units from the same faction, or mix and match from multiple armies, leveraging the best traits of each. Besides factions, we're also introducing classes to let you further customize your army: Enjoy playing more defensive? Build a full tank army! Want more damage? Play warriors or assassin! Or just keep a healthy mixture of all of these. The choice is entirely yours.

You'll get to explore the dungeon by discovering different nodes; forge nodes will allow you to craft items and upgrade your units, while the merchant node will offer you goodies to help you with your journey! Perhaps you'll find hidden treasure or magical shrines to give you an edge. Who knows what truly lies beneath the ground? 

With each floor the enemies in the dungeon become increasingly stronger. 

And when your inevitable death arrives, you'll get to start anew with a new character of your choosing!

Once we get enough feedback on the new systems, we'll start working on the Overworld Exploration game mode. This is where we tie everything together.

You'll get to choose a starting faction. You get a base and a hero. You'll be able to move around in the world with your hero in a turn-based style. Explore new areas, gather resources, capture mines, fight enemies. Upgrading your base allows you to recruit better units into your army. Capturing your enemies castles and defeating their heroes will earn you a victory.



We are currently steadily working on making the dungeon generation process feel as good as possible. In this first iteration we'll be using procedural generation for the dungeon floors, but for the Overworld exploration we'll create a full blown map editor. Oh, and one more thing; we'll also expose the map editor to you all, so you can create and share your own maps with your friends and other players.



You'll be able to play with or against other players in the Overworld Exploration mode. The game is going to be peer to peer, so no servers on our end (unless you, the community, wants us to run official ones).

Besides that, the game is now becoming a mostly offline single player experience as a premium title.

As for pricing, we have not yet decided. We'll have to see. Anywhere in the $15-30 range is a possibility as of now.



If you want to follow the development, join our discord server:

 https://discord.gg/tirunia

notes.title: Tales of Tirunia - First Public Playtest Announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we are running our first public playtesting session on July 12-13! You can request access through our Steam page. Request will be granted to everyone automatically before the event starts!

It's been a long journey, but we are finally here. Our first public playtest session will contain 4 playable armies:

 Wild Terins
 High Terins
 Radiants
 Bog Fiends


You will be able to hop into an intense 1v1 PVP match against a random opponent or directly challenge your friends through a private lobby system.
If you need practice, the PVE Practice mode will provide a great opportunity to test and improve your skills against a bot. Don't be mistaken; most people have a really hard time beating the bot for their first couple of games!

The most dedicated playtesters will be awarded with the Magical Forest bundle; including a new Battlefield skin, a new unit frame and a new unit portal skin - that will be unlocked at the full launch of the game.

We want to hear your feedback

Whether you love or hate the game, we'd love to hear your thoughts on it. You can either post on Steam - we will keep an eye on all the discussion there -, or you can join our Discord server and chat to us directly.

How does the game work
If you want to learn a bit about the game before jumping in, check out this Youtube video created by our lead dev, Balint.

[previewyoutube=2atGeOLrP_8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are a very small indie company and we are super excited about taking our first game public. We'd love to build and connect with our community, so feel free to hop into our Discord server for a chat. Everyone's welcome!
